scope: Phone-local normal TAH V0/V1/V2+ UI contract; exceptions/background deferred; main owns runtime integration.

boundary.required: EXACT TAHFramework -> ProviderAdapter -> ProviderBackend; no downgrade/rewrite absent P0 blocker. Phone owns orchestration; no Mac/USB calls or restart per attempt.

normal_path.input: Completed nonempty turns -> immutable [HH:MM:SS - HH:MM:SS] + trimmed text/newline.
normal_path.wire: UTF-8 JSON {transcriptID,title,rawTranscript}; beginTranscript({id,transcriptID,byteLength,sha256}), transcriptChunk(id,index,data) 64KiB, finishTranscript(id). Hash JSON bytes; ACKs; material/{id}.

normal_path.output: TAHRawSafetySnapshot {state,busy,activeCheckID,consentGranted,checkedAt,expiresAt,explanation,interactionLanguage,reasonCodes,...}. Poll raw.status; require unexpired allowed.
normal_path.semantics: Explicit authorized/consented check; reads never infer. Profile guardian inference, Web=false; ALLOW/BLOCK, no files. 60-day cache key=provider/profile+guardian model/effort+raw+prompt+policy, excluding language. Reuse valid receipt/recorded explanation.
newAction(.structuredNotes): authorized/raw allowed; metadata only. App type structured-notes; Framework structured_notes / structured_notes/v1. Same ID/payload idempotent.
sendAction(TAHActionSend); requestID=operationID. Checkpoint draft; <=64KiB instructions; V0 optional,V1+ nonblank. started=admitted. Same ID requires identical payload.

Index=accepted count; append delta to accepted ledger. Empty V0 skips ExtraGuardian; otherwise check raw,contract,ledger/delta,history,actor Web (own Web=false). ALLOW -> commitProposal -> actor -> Rule Critic -> PASS -> publishRevision. One repair round on first rejection, not a revision.
normal_path.output: {kind:completed,admittedLedger,proposalCommitID,publicationCommitID,outcome,criticRounds,actorRounds:1|2,finalText} after receipt. Next send uses all accepted history; old raw/outcomes immutable.

settings.draftDTO: TAHRevisionDraftSettings={providerID?,modelID,reasoningEffortID?,contextWindowTokens?,webEnabled}, nullable fields. Use policy-filtered auth.snapshot.actorCatalog, its handles/efforts/context defaults.
settings.outputLanguage: en|zh-CN distinct from ASR/app language; initialLanguage editable until first send, then frozen at operation start/persistence (not success). Future model/effort/Web remain mutable.
settings.interactionLanguage: App preference sampled per raw-check/send (default en): commentary/final,Guardian explanation,ASR-index; notes use output language. Preserve quotes/names/code/URLs; history language unchanged.
settings.perRevision: Capture model/effort/context/Web each operation; Web can turn off again. Guardian inference profile-fixed. Model change chooses default/first effort/default context; provider change clears mutable selection. Reject unsupported saved settings, no silent substitution.

read_and_render.snapshot: action.snapshot({actionID}) -> TAHActionSnapshot; action.list({transcriptID,cursor}) -> {actions,nextCursor},32/page. phase/editorMode/editorToken control editor. Accepted revisions={revisionIndex,providerID,actorRounds,commitID,modelID,reasoningEffortID,contextWindowTokens}; no historical Web field.
read_and_render.progress: ui.actionChanged(actionID,operationID,sourceID,sourceRevision,phase,presentation,events,pendingSave): refresh snapshot/history. preparing -> extra_guardian/saving_safety? -> actor -> critic -> completed; persistence_pending possible. Only public actor events+host extra-safety-pass.
read_and_render.history: action.conversation({actionID,cursor:null|string}) -> {items,nextCursor}: descending positions,8-record scan/96KiB. Merge id/sort ascending; cycleID replaces optimistic row. Visible=accepted+current non-editing. final_answer requires completed+publication/{cycleID}; plain user text,Markdown final,separate critic/log; no private reasoning/uncommitted final.
read_and_render.files: action.outcome({actionID,revisionIndex,path,offset}): accepted structured-notes.md (1..8MiB), suspicious-asr-terms.md (1..1MiB). action.transcriptMaterial({actionID,offset}): raw. -> {data:base64,totalBytes},<=48KiB; byte offsets, concatenate then UTF-8. action.conversationText({actionID,position,offset}) expands 1500-char preview; action.workingText({actionID,position:int|null,sha256,offset}) reads public log.
read_and_render.ui: Raw tab + Notes/ASR terms for all accepted Vn; open latest, retain history. Links require snapshot.revisions. Framework publishes without user approval.

reuse.DTOs: T: TAHActionSend,TAHActionSnapshot,TAHRevisionDraftSettings,TAHRawSafetySnapshot,TAHActionProgress,TAHActionPresentation,TAHConversationPage,TAHModelCatalog; L: TAHInteractionLanguage. Foundation DTOs; U renderer/M reader.
reuse.UI: No SwiftUI TAHViews in current Sources. React refs: V ActionHome/RawSafety/Composer; H Timeline/Message/Working/Material. N methods: present/checkRawSafety/newAction/modelChanged/send/selectSavedAction/loadConversation/expandConversation. Preserve draft/editorToken; adapt AppKit/transport. No UI copied.

validation.performed: Static JSON/anchor/hash check only; no build/model/phone/network/commit.
validation.priorEvidence: ALMA-litter/tools/alma-ios-lab/README.md:5-19: Mac-orchestrated phone small-sample acceptance; not autonomous UI/background.
